svg.title: 4K NVIDIA browser frame visible with GPU compositing and sandbox; sustained browser acceptance open; backend 4 of 8; desktop product 0 of 4
svg.desc: A public-source enabled regression passes 1800 GPU handoffs, complete source and SDL pixels, input response, application replacement and live cleanup. A new owner/controller agreement selects a 4 GiB shared reported-usage pool after current native headroom checks. This run has zero deferred evictions; a separate default-off regression retains positive eviction, reuse and reclamation coverage. A later private integration displays a readable Chromium page and shader with GPU compositing enabled and all 17 observed GPU threads sandboxed, but fails the sustained/input test after two handoffs. Normal launcher, daily use, pressure recovery, broader APIs and matched-native performance remain open. Updated October 26, 2026.

g.text: First Hyprland frame achieved · Complete GPU backbuffer: 3840×2160
Latest: sandboxed Chromium page and shader visible; GPU compositing enabled
Sustained browser/input, pressure recovery and daily-use acceptance remain open
Next: input/scrolling/resize, close/reopen and sustained multi-window browsing
Green: demonstrated · Amber: in progress · Gray: pending · Updated 2026-10-26
Real guest GPU source: 3840×2160 · SDL backbuffer: 2560×1566 · Physical 4K scanout unverified
Checklist counts do not measure engineering effort or product readiness.
